final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias reference: sink IREF with diode-connected nfet
MB0 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=1
* tail current source
MT  tail  ibias vss vss nfet W=12 L=1
* NMOS input pair (M1 = vinn side, diode-load side; M2 = vinp side, output side)
M1  n1 vinn tail vss nfet W=10 L=0.5
M2  n2 vinp tail vss nfet W=10 L=0.5
* PMOS mirror load
M3  n1 n1 vdd vdd pfet W=8 L=0.5
M4  n2 n1 vdd vdd pfet W=8 L=0.5
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS current sink
M6  vout n2 vdd vdd pfet W=64 L=0.5
M7  vout ibias vss vss nfet W=48 L=1
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
RZ  n2 nc 2000
CC  nc vout 1e-12
.ends dut
